inference.note: min_box_area is a post-filter applied after Ultralytics predict (boxes < 50 px^2 dropped)

evaluation_policy.primary: Primary = REVIEW regions ignored (eval_ignore_regions.json), IoU 0.5, IoA 0.5, 101-pt AP, min_pred_area 50. Sub-threshold PROPOSED ignores reported as secondary only (not approved).
evaluation_policy.labels: PROVISIONAL automated S2-H VALID boxes (not human-verified)

selection_rules.checkpoint: Keep best.pt (provisional primary, user decision) unless a comparison candidate exceeds its primary ignore-aware AP50 by more than 0.005 (below that, differences are within single-seed checkpoint-to-checkpoint noise).
selection_rules.threshold: Recall-oriented: the LOWEST threshold in the grid whose F1 is within 0.02 of the best F1 on the grid (recall gained at negligible F1 cost; a missed obstacle costs more than a false alarm).
selection_rules.nms: Unchanged from the evaluation that produced the candidates: NMS IoU 0.6, max_det 300, imgsz 736, plus min box area 50 px^2.
selection_rules.evaluation_policy: Primary = REVIEW regions ignored (eval_ignore_regions.json), IoU 0.5, IoA 0.5, 101-pt AP, min_pred_area 50. Sub-threshold PROPOSED ignores reported as secondary only (not approved).
